summary: OpenTelemetry integration fails when running Temporal locally because the Tempo container fails to start due to a YAML configuration parsing error - fields in the checked-in config file no longer exist in the current Tempo version.
userImpact: Developers cannot collect or view tracing information when running Temporal locally, preventing effective use of observability tools during development.
rootCause: Tempo container's configuration format changed in a breaking way, rendering the checked-in config outdated with nonexistent fields (ingester, compactor, traces_storage, local_blocks).
proposedFix: Update the checked-in Tempo configuration file to match the new format required by the current Tempo version.
resolutionDetails: Configuration file was updated to match the current Tempo format via PR submitted by author.
keyQuote: This looks like it was just some breaking change in the config file format that Tempo is loading.
